findings.highlight: She listens
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは喜んで聞いていた
findings.governingReading: Illya listened gladly
findings.explanation: Illya’s pleasure in hearing ordinary, meaningless talk is omitted.

findings.highlight: my pointless rambling and mundane stories
findings.evidenceJa: なんの意味もない話、ありきたりの出来事
findings.governingReading: meaningless talk and commonplace events
findings.explanation: The neutral content of their conversation is recast as Shirou rambling.

findings.highlight: did it start getting painful
findings.evidenceJa: それが痛ましく思えてしまった
findings.governingReading: did I begin to find that pitiable and painful
findings.explanation: Shirou’s compassionate judgment of Illya’s situation becomes an impersonal onset of pain.

findings.highlight: an innocent girl
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に無邪気な女の子
findings.governingReading: a truly innocent girl
findings.explanation: The narration’s emphatic judgment of Illya’s genuine innocence is weakened.

findings.highlight: has no doubts about it
findings.evidenceJa: マスターである自分を躊躇わない事
findings.governingReading: does not hesitate at being a Master herself
findings.explanation: Illya’s lack of moral or personal hesitation is compressed into generic absence of doubt.

findings.highlight: I think her lack of fear about going into battle is sad
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤがマスターである事、マスターである自分を躊躇わない事。戦いに赴く自分に恐れを感じていない事が、ひどく、哀しい
findings.governingReading: that she is a Master, does not hesitate to be one, and feels no fear at going to battle strikes me as terribly sad
findings.explanation: Three linked grounds for Shirou’s sorrow are collapsed into only Illya’s lack of fear.

findings.highlight: a result of their thousand-year-old history
findings.evidenceJa: 千年の執念の果てに
findings.governingReading: at the end of a thousand years of obsession
findings.explanation: The Einzberns’ sustained obsessive drive is neutralized into the age of their history.

findings.highlight: She is sent out as the greatest Master
findings.evidenceJa: 最高のマスターとして送り出された幼い少女
findings.governingReading: a young girl sent out as the supreme Master
findings.explanation: The contrast between Illya’s youth and engineered status is omitted.

findings.highlight: I have to ask her this question
findings.evidenceJa: この問いだけは、口にしなければならなかった
findings.governingReading: this question alone had to be spoken aloud
findings.explanation: The exceptional necessity of this one question and its voiced form are reduced.

findings.highlight: The air freezes
findings.evidenceJa: 時間が止まる
findings.governingReading: time stops
findings.explanation: A literalized subjective halt in time is replaced by a conventional atmospheric image.

findings.highlight: The silence is dead
findings.evidenceJa: 今までの時間が消え去ってしまうほどの、無感情な沈黙
findings.governingReading: an emotionless silence so complete it erases all the time until now
findings.explanation: The silence’s lack of emotion and its erasure of the preceding hour are replaced by vague “deadness.”

findings.highlight: It’s getting late
findings.evidenceJa: そろそろ夕暮れ
findings.governingReading: it is nearly twilight
findings.explanation: The approach of the day-night boundary governing Master conduct is generalized.

findings.highlight: Illya waves goodbye
findings.evidenceJa: 無邪気な少女のまま、ばいばい、と別れを告げる
findings.governingReading: still an innocent girl, Illya says “bye-bye”
findings.explanation: Illya’s unchanged innocent aspect and childish verbal farewell disappear, while an unsupported wave is added.

findings.highlight: This is all the rest I’ll get
findings.evidenceJa: 休憩はここまでだ
findings.governingReading: the respite ends here
findings.explanation: The end of this particular peaceful interval becomes a broader limit on all rest available to Shirou.

findings.highlight: We will be enemies again
findings.evidenceJa: 敵として戦わなければならない
findings.governingReading: we must fight as enemies
findings.explanation: The necessity of actual combat after sunset is reduced to enemy status.

findings.highlight: Can I talk with you again
findings.evidenceJa: また会えるかな
findings.governingReading: I wonder if I can see you again
findings.explanation: Shirou asks to meet Illya again; the English narrows this to another conversation.

findings.highlight: Do you want to see me again, Shirou?
findings.evidenceJa: わたしはそうでもないんだけど、シロウは会いたい？
findings.governingReading: I am not especially eager, but do you want to see me?
findings.explanation: Illya’s defensive pretense that she is not interested is omitted.

findings.highlight: Don’t expect too much and keep waiting
findings.evidenceJa: 期待しないで待っててね
findings.governingReading: wait for me without expecting me
findings.explanation: The teasing contradiction between waiting and having no expectation becomes an awkward command to continue waiting.

findings.highlight: She suddenly stops
findings.evidenceJa: 白い少女は不意に足を止めて
findings.governingReading: the white girl suddenly stops
findings.explanation: The visual epithet linking Illya’s pale appearance to the moment of reversal is omitted.

findings.highlight: I was given birth to this world to win the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 生まれた理由は聖杯戦争に勝つことだけ
findings.governingReading: the sole reason I was born was to win the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: The exclusivity of Illya’s engineered birth purpose is omitted and “to this world” is added.

findings.highlight: My mission is to kill you and Kiritsugu
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの目的は、キリツグとシロウを殺す事
findings.governingReading: Illya’s own purpose is to kill Kiritsugu and Shirou
findings.explanation: Her personally distinguished purpose is recast as an assigned mission.

findings.highlight: She sprints off
findings.evidenceJa: 去っていく足音
findings.governingReading: the sound of footsteps receding
findings.explanation: An auditory image that withholds visual manner is replaced by a visible sprint.
